title: KOB token registry
description: A pinned snapshot of facts: the token programs this build supports and facts about tokens that anyone can re-derive from the chain. No per-token judgement (no listing, official status or written warnings: curation belongs to external community lists). Structure only: cross-field rules (family/template agreement, extension commitment rules, duplicate identities, confusable tickers, genesis-record consistency, slot-limit consistency) are enforced by kob_protocol::registry::Registry::validate.

review_status.description: the program allowlist: only reviewed templates are on the strict list, the programs this build supports for trading (a token on one of them is tradable). A statement about a program, never about a token

escrow.description: kcc20: owner_scheme 4 and borrow_scheme 0. kron: id_type 2, is_minter 0, delivery_id_type 3 or 0.

capabilities.description: what the program's authorities can do beyond owner-authorised transfers; freeze, seize and blacklist are labelled in every UI. Optional, default none

risks.description: declared risks of the program that are not a capability (missing hardening, signing assumptions); shown next to the capabilities. Optional, default none

x.description: the token's X (Twitter) account, https:// address (the issuance form writes https://x.com/<handle>). Optional

telegram.description: the token's Telegram, https:// address (the issuance form writes https://t.me/<handle>). Optional

warning_code.description: token warning codes of the API data model (kob_protocol::registry::TokenWarning, the executor's /v1/tokens `warnings`). Derived from the recorded facts by code, not stored in this file: genesis_unverified = the entry does not say genesis_verified: true (every open-list token without an entry carries it); live_mint_authority = the genesis record lists live mint-authority cells (the supply can still grow)

genesis_record.description: what the genesis check (C1) and the live-mint-authority check (C2) found, re-derived from registry/evidence/ by kob registry verify-genesis. Needs genesis_verified. Optional

txid.description: genesis transaction id (recomputed from the recorded transaction)

daa_score.description: DAA score of the block that accepted the genesis

outputs.description: output indices of the genesis group, strictly increasing

minter_outputs.description: genesis outputs carrying a mint authority (KRON is_minter != 0; the PublicMint outputs of a kcc20-ref-public-mint token); empty proves the token never has a live minter

mint_allowance.description: sum of the remaining allowance of the genesis PublicMint outputs (kcc20-ref-public-mint tokens); absent = no public minter. Maximum supply = supply + mint_allowance; needs minter_outputs

live_minters.description: live mint-authority cells (txid:index; for kcc20-ref-public-mint the live PublicMint cells with remaining > 0): [] = none (C2 holds), absent = not determined; non-empty gives the derived warning live_mint_authority

checked_at_daa.description: virtual DAA score of the node the check read liveness from

source.description: where the bytes came from (node, explorer, issuer) and how they were checked

extension_commitment.description: required for kcc20, null for kron

lot_size.description: legacy (protocol v2 lots): read and ignored; protocol v3 orders have no lot

tick.description: legacy (protocol v2 price tick): read and ignored

status.description: legacy (the listing state of older files, a per-token judgement KOB no longer makes): read and ignored, whatever it holds; never written

official.description: legacy (the official badge of older files): read and ignored, whatever it holds; never written. Curation belongs to external community lists

warning.description: legacy (a maintainer warning text of older files): read and ignored, whatever it holds; never written. The warnings a token carries are derived from its facts (warning_code)

verified.description: the covenant id and template hash were checked against a chain UTXO of the token (the UTXO is an instance of the template): a fact anyone can re-derive, not an endorsement

genesis_verified.description: Genesis check: true = EVERY output of the token's genesis group was revealed and is an instance of its program (kob_protocol::registry::verify_genesis); false = checked and NOT clean; absent = not checked. Needs verified; without true the API attaches the warning genesis_unverified. Optional

display.description: a snapshot of what the token declares about itself (KCC-23) or of neutral facts, not an endorsement. Optional
